name: San Diego Newcomers 2024

venue.name: UC San Diego

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanDiegoNewcomers2024#32930-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbnhmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7ba00c92956d73843dac03263db2d54fe08848f8/image.png)

This competition is a part of the WCA New Competitor Month initiative. Please refer to the [WCA Newcomer Month Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanDiegoNewcomers2024#38166-wca-newcomer-month-information) tab for more information.
